page_title: VER 2-3 TOR | Verona v Torino 20/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Livio Marinelli has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Ali Dembele (Torino) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
90+3' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+3' 2 - 3 Goal - 2:3! Reda Belahyane tees up Daniel Mosquera (Verona) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
90+2' That will be all from Samuele Ricci who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alieu Njie (Torino).
90+1' The resulting corner from Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' A cross into the box from Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Torino will take a corner.
89' The shots on goal statistics – 1:3.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mathis Lambourde (Verona) for Jackson Tchatchoua.
85' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
82' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Ali Dembele (Torino) replaces Sebastian Walukiewicz.
82' Reda Belahyane (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Livio Marinelli blows for a foul.
80' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) blows a big chance to score! He slammed the ball from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it went narrowly over the crossbar.
79' 1 - 3 Che Adams (Torino) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!
77' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
73' The corner from Dani Silva (Verona) is intercepted by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
72' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
72' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Dani Silva (Verona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
68' Substitution. Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) in, Grigoris Kastanos out.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Casper Tengstedt will be replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
67' Here is a change. Ivan Ilic is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
67' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Adrien Tameze and he is replaced by Karol Linetty (Torino).
67' Substitution. Antonio Sanabria makes his way off the pitch and Che Adams (Torino) comes on as his replacement.
67' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

66' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
63' 4:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.
61' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
60' Samuele Ricci (Torino) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
60' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
58' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
56' Borna Sosa (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
53' Some great controlled play and passing from Torino. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
51' The ball possession at the moment is 24:76.
48' Torino are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.
47' Adrien Tameze (Torino) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Torino will have a corner.
46' Paolo Zanetti makes a half-time substitution. Flavius Daniliuc (Verona) comes on in place of Darko Lazovic.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Verona players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
44' Verona are seeing far more of the ball now.

42' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) hits a screaming first-time shot from the edge of the box from a clearance, but it flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
41' Torino are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
39' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and signals a foul after Darko Lazovic (Verona) brought his opponent down.

38' It looked like the long-range shot by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
35' The Torino players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
33' 1 - 2 Goal! Duvan Zapata (Torino) makes the score 1:2 after burying a close-range header in the top left corner after a good run and cross by Valentino Lazaro.

33' Verona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

30' Ambitious effort from Darko Lazovic (Verona). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
29' Wonderful movement by Torino. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
28' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
27' Amin Sarr goes off the pitch and Martin Frese (Verona) comes on.
26' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
26' Torino are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
22' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
22' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
21' It's a penalty to Torino! Let's see who's going to take it.
21' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
20' Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to intercept the corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
18' Diego Coppola (Verona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
17' Verona keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
14' Great teamplay by Verona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

12' 1 - 1 It's in! Darko Lazovic spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) doesn't think twice and curls a first-time shot into the top right corner. The score is now 1:1.
12' Darko Lazovic (Verona) works the corner short.
12' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
10' 0 - 1 Antonio Sanabria (Torino) dribbles into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. Sensational solo goal.
7' Verona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Torino are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
3' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
2' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Torino players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Torino will kick the game off.
Livio Marinelli was nominated as the referee for this game.
